subject: Your 45-day Sound DNA is ready
preview_text: You've been listening for 45 days. Here's what your audio habits say about you.
body_paragraphs: 45 days ago, you downloaded Loudify. Since then, you've tuned your headphones, pushed past the volume wall, and made every commute, game, and audiobook cleaner. You're not a new user anymore—you're part of the 100,000 who listen differently.

This is where most people stop and settle. But the ones who keep going don't just hear louder—they hear smarter. Your Sound DNA recap is waiting: a breakdown of how you listened, which profiles you used most, and how your audio preferences evolved. It's a report that actually matters.

Open Loudify now and check your Weekly Sound DNA. You'll see your top listening hours, your go-to EQ tweaks, and a score that compares to the global Top Streaks leaderboard. This isn't a gimmick—it's your audio fingerprint.
One tap to see it: Open the app, tap your profile, and view your Sound DNA. P.S. Premium users get the full history, not just this week. If you want the complete picture, it's one toggle away.
